X.note: Terrain map with a row of 10 coins against 1 coin makes the 10:1 canal-vs-wagon cost gap clear at a glance. Labels are large and high-contrast, and the caption explains the coin unit. The coins are flat, sticker-like discs rather than true 3D objects. The wagon and boat icons are small and clip-art-like. The wagon coin row sits under the callout, which crowds it slightly. The 'ACTUAL' tag is repeated three times.

Y.note: Dark, empty grid with three plain cubes. The left callout covers the top of the orange cube. The right '13%' callout is semi-transparent and its text is dim teal on dark, so 'of total construction cost (range)' is hard to read on a phone. The middle '6%' has no description, so it has no stated meaning. The cubes are not clearly scaled to the values: 7%, 6% and 13% have nearly the same heights, and the 13% cube is the smallest or equal. The scene has no context, and the long caption is mostly a disclaimer.

why: X shows a clear quantity comparison in a real setting with readable labels, while Y has an overlapping, faded label, an unlabeled value and cubes whose sizes contradict their numbers.
top_fix_for_weaker: Make all three callouts opaque with the same high-contrast text, and move them so they don't cover the cubes. Give the 6% a description, and scale the cube heights to the values (13% about twice the 7%). Add a clear label or icon to say what each cube represents.
